name: Itsuki
source: Itsuki as a girl after her friend Mii gave her magical soap. Because she was bathing with Mii when she used the soap the flavor of mint is not enough to change her back into a boy. She must have sex with Mii in order to become a boy again. The flavor of lemon will change her back into a girl.
